stance_rationale: Governor v3.0 admits PD20 Path 2 by reframing a turnover hard-fail as a Hurdle v2.3 mandate before the PD20-specific Judge/DSR/5-spec/statistical and canonical schedule evidence exists. The draft is transparent about many gaps, but transparency plus post-hoc amendment is not admission-grade process compliance under AX-002/AX-008.

scenario_rule_audit.rule_misapplication_evidence: The draft labels the case as integration, but also says FULL_SUPERSEDE_ALL_AXES and mutates the active 5-sleeve book into a 4-sleeve composite. That is replacement/consolidation in economic effect, yet replacement-grade same-cost Harvey/DSR/multi-testing evidence for PD20 Path 2 is absent.

family_saturation_audit.new_strategy_family: Composite KR Equity: STR_1715 quality/AR score plus NEW vol/skew D-family score
family_saturation_audit.baseline_family_overlap: S4 already has a KR equity core sleeve; PD20 composite is 81.8% STR_1715 score and 18.2% NEW score, with TDC 0.438 shared KR-equity tail risk.

multi_objective_audit.pareto_count: Draft reports 3/4 strict improve, but consistent CVaR arithmetic makes it 2/4 vs S4 because PD20 Path 2 CVaR -5.53% is worse than baseline -5.01%.
multi_objective_audit.single_axis_compensating: SR and CAGR are strong, but DM t_NW=2.764 fails Harvey-Liu-Zhu strict bar and no PD20 composite DSR/5-spec evidence is present.

ax_008_triangulation.lockbox_alternative_validation: Insufficient for PD20 Path 2: Forge PD20-B self-discloses turnover hard fail under v2.2 and pending DSR/5-spec; Codex PD20-B is REJECT; Architect evidence is inherited from prior PD18/PD16 context, not a PD20 Path 2 independent PASS.

critical_concerns.description: The scenario is misclassified. A FULL_SUPERSEDE 5-sleeve to 4-sleeve book mutation is economically a replacement/consolidation, but the draft avoids replacement-grade direct comparison: PD20 Path 2 lacks same-cost DSR, CAPM/Carhart/FF5/FF6 Harvey regressions, and multi-testing penalty evidence.

Statistical robustness is overclaimed. The draft says DSR/Harvey/MDD relief are met, but forge_package_pd20b says composite DSR and 5-spec Harvey are pending, and the only PD20 Path 2 target-level statistic is DM t_NW=2.764, which fails the strict t>3 Harvey-Liu-Zhu bar.

Canonical schedule evidence fails. qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260511_001/weights.csv is missing, qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260511_001 is missing, and stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001/weights.csv is the stale 155-date high_20pct 5-sleeve schedule ending 2023-11, not the 184-date PD20 Path 2 4-sleeve composite schedule.

The Hurdle v2.3 amendment converts a measured turnover breach into an admission pass without a completed Charter amendment. PD20 Path 2 has 685.1% portfolio-weighted round-trip turnover and 1245.7% composite-sleeve round-trip turnover; under the base hard constraint and prior Hurdle v2.2 this is a fail, not a resolved gate.

PIT-C13/C14 remain future obligations, not current compliance. alpha_package marks c13/c14 true while also stating strict C13 hard fail remains due to the extra direction layer and Usable_Date audit is pending; using the 2024-2026 alpha extension as primary PD20 evidence carries that unresolved PIT risk forward.

AX-008 is overcounted by excluding Codex REJECT and inheriting non-PD20 Architect/Forge partial evidence. The role/base requirement is at least two PASS sources among Forge, Codex, and Architect; PD20 Path 2 currently has Forge blocked/conditional, Codex REJECT, and no independent PD20 Architect PASS.

The AX-007/TDC waiver scope is stretched. qlead_ax007_exception_1_waiver.json is explicitly TDC-only and med_10pct-candidate scoped, but the draft inherits it into a new PD20 Path 2 composite plus production-cap and turnover-amendment decision.

The multi-objective pass count is internally inconsistent. The draft calls CVaR a strict-improve pass even though it separately reports PD20 Path 2 CVaR -5.53% versus S4 baseline -5.01%, a 0.52pp deterioration; this weakens the claimed 3/4 strict-improve basis.

supporting_arguments: stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001/alpha_scores.parquet is a real time-series artifact: 62,916 rows, 184 sig_dates from 2011-01-01 to 2026-04-01, 770 tickers, no duplicate sig_date-Ticker pairs.
stage_artifacts/WT_D20260511_001/covariance.parquet passes PSD/conditioning on the inspected 100x100 matrix: min eigenvalue 0.0121714, condition number 8.812 <= 100.
PD20 Path 2 does improve headline SR/CAGR versus S4 baseline: SR 2.1574 vs 1.8334 and CAGR 27.01% vs 20.20%, with MDD still under the project -25% target.

The draft does disclose major blockers, including turnover amendment B7, PIT-C13/C14 PD13, and Codex PD20 Round pending; the issue is admission timing and evidence sufficiency, not silent absence of all caveats.
unresolved_disputes: Whether a same-day Q-Lead turnover cap change from 600% to 800% can override the base hard turnover constraint before formal Charter adoption.
Whether PD20 Path 2 can be admitted before PD20-specific DSR M=19 and 5-spec Harvey tests exist.
Whether the missing mailbox weights.csv and stale root stage weights.csv can satisfy the walk-forward schedule promise.
Whether operational lockbox refresh for 2024-2026 can be primary admit evidence without Pre-LB/Lockbox/Combined reporting.
Whether the med_10pct TDC-only waiver legally carries into the PD20 composite replacement structure.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest assumption is that a post-hoc Hurdle v2.3 turnover amendment plus inherited med_10pct/TDC waiver can convert PD20 Path 2 from a Forge-disclosed hard-fail/pending-statistics candidate into an admission-grade book replacement.
rebuttal_required: Publish the canonical qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-D20260511_001/weights.csv for PD20 Path 2 and prove it is consumed by the backtest, not hardcoded.
Run PD20 Path 2 composite DSR with full trial count and CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6 regressions using the same cost basis for candidate and baseline.
Complete PIT-C13/C14 remediation or explicitly mark admission as blocked until the Z_Score_Aligned-only and Usable_Date audit passes.
Formalize the Hurdle v2.3 amendment with scope, effective date, and interaction with the base 600% hard constraint.
Recompute the 4-axis strict improve table and fix the CVaR pass/fail arithmetic.
Obtain a PD20-specific Architect verification or stop counting inherited PD18/PD16 Architect evidence for AX-008.
rationalization_red_flags: 600% cap은 보수적이며 alpha quality dominant 시 800%까지 허용 가능
governor_specific_questions: 사용자/Judge가 명시한 시나리오(replacement vs sequential)에 맞는 룰이 적용됐는가? No: economic replacement/consolidation is labeled integration.
baseline의 Harvey gate FAIL이 admission 결정에 반영됐는가? Not applicable as baseline Harvey appears PASS; the problem is new PD20 Path 2 Harvey/DSR absence.
family saturation 평가가 baseline에도 동일하게 적용됐는가 (이중 잣대 회피)? No: the baseline KR equity family and 81.8% STR_1715 dominance in the composite are not symmetrically penalized.
single-axis (Harvey/DSR) 우월 vs multi-objective weighted score trade-off 명시됐는가? No: PD20 Path 2 has no completed Harvey/DSR superiority evidence.
